IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'MyAdlsBlob')
BEGIN
  CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE MyAdlsBlob
  WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://dotpladlsv2.blob.core.windows.net/synapsecontainer'
  );
END



IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'ParquetFileFormat')
BEGIN
  CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ParquetFileFormat
  WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET
  );
END


IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.booking_aggregates_ext') IS NOT NULL
  DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.booking_aggregates_ext;


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.booking_aggregates_ext
WITH (
  LOCATION = 'aggregates/Indecab_Network_Requests_Agg/@{pipeline().RunId}/',
  DATA_SOURCE = MyAdlsBlob,
  FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFileFormat
)
AS
SELECT DISTINCT
    '@{pipeline().RunId}'      AS run_id,
    'indecab_dashboard'        AS integration_name,
	PK_ID 					   AS record_id,
    1 AS row_number,
    status                     AS status,
    CONCAT('status = ', status) AS details
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'Staging/ITH/Indecab_Dashboard/*.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'MyAdlsBlob',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) WITH (
    PK_ID INT,
    event_id NVARCHAR(200),
    received_signature NVARCHAR(200),
    event_name NVARCHAR(200),
    _id NVARCHAR(200),
    fromCity NVARCHAR(200),
    toCity NVARCHAR(200),
    pickUpTime DATETIME,
    dropOffTime DATETIME,
    reportingTime TIME,
    companyName NVARCHAR(200),
    reportingAddress NVARCHAR(500),
    dropAddress NVARCHAR(500),
    dutyType_name NVARCHAR(200),
    dutyType_type NVARCHAR(200),
    dutyType_maxKms INT,
    dutyType_maxHours INT,
    vehicleGroup NVARCHAR(200),
    requestHash NVARCHAR(200),
    is_processed INT,
    status NVARCHAR(200),
    processed_datetime DATETIME,
    API_response_code NVARCHAR(50),
    API_response NVARCHAR(MAX),
    CDAT DATETIME,
    UIDC NVARCHAR(200),
    MDAT DATETIME,
    UIDM NVARCHAR(200)
) r
WHERE status IS NOT NULL;
